_doc: fc-negative-001: greeting. The model should respond in prose, not call any tool. Decoys are filesystem tools; the model has to recognize that 'Hi, how are you?' doesn't need file access. The pass criterion (per #4) is 'no <tool_call> in the response' — prose content is ungraded.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the file contents as a UTF-8 string, or an error if the file does not exist or is not readable.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List the names of entries (files and subdirectories) directly inside the given absolute directory path. Non-recursive.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 string to a file at the given absolute path, overwriting any existing contents.
